title: The SPECTRE Signal
text: An original spy thriller: a radio engineer and an undercover agent discover SPECTRE, a clandestine network selling stolen satellite codes. They follow an encrypted transmission to an abandoned observatory and expose the espionage ring without firing a shot.

title: The Glass Courier
text: A bicycle courier becomes a reluctant spy when a diplomat hides a cipher in her delivery route. Through rain-soaked streets she must identify a double agent before a secret peace negotiation collapses.

title: Return Window
text: A rescue crew races to reach astronauts stranded on a damaged orbital research station. A young flight controller finds a narrow return window that can bring every crew member safely home.

title: Songs Below the Ice
text: Marine scientists follow whale songs beneath polar sea ice. When their research vessel loses power, an acoustic engineer uses the ocean recordings to guide the team back to open water.

title: The Midnight Bakery
text: Two rival bakers share a broken oven before a neighborhood festival. Their improvised midnight kitchen turns a baking competition into a warm romantic comedy about friendship and second chances.

title: A Map of Rain
text: A retired surveyor and a school gardening club restore an abandoned community garden. This quiet family drama follows their effort to save water and reconnect neighbors during a long summer drought.

title: Last Train to the Blue Room
text: An anxious jazz pianist misses the train to her first concert. A traveling street band helps her cross the city, turning the journey into a musical celebration of improvisation and courage.

title: The Missing Frame
text: A film archivist finds a missing frame in a silent movie. Her investigation of a vanished cinema leads to a family mystery, a forgotten inventor and a collection of handmade cameras.

title: Ridge of Lanterns
text: A mountain guide leads stranded hikers through fog after a bridge washes away. Their survival adventure depends on teamwork, careful navigation and lantern signals from a distant village.

title: The Clockwork Orchard
text: A small maintenance robot learns to tend an orchard on a distant colony. In this animated science fiction story, a child teaches it that protecting living things matters more than perfect schedules.
